body:
Phase 3 items 3.2 + 3.3 of docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md (READ IT FIRST). Builds on T24.

=== VERIFIED pi API FACTS (0.80.3) ===
- `ctx.ui.setWidget(key, content: string[] | undefined, { placement?: 'aboveEditor' (default) | other WidgetPlacement values })` — a persistent text widget; pass undefined to remove. Also `setStatus(key, text)` for the footer pill (already used for the ticket).
- `pi.registerMessageRenderer(customType, renderer)` — custom rendering for messages sent with that customType (the flail advisory already sends customType 'adlc-flail-advisory'). Read the MessageRenderer type in types.d.ts for the exact render contract before implementing.
- `ctx.getContextUsage() -> {tokens, contextWindow, percent}` (may be unavailable — degrade).
- ANSI escape sequences are already used in the existing status pill; keep widget content theme-agnostic (plain text + the same minimal ANSI usage as the pill).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. lib/widget.mjs: a renderWidgetLines(state) pure function producing 1–3 short lines from { ticketId, ticketTitle, enforcement: 'active'|'error'|'inert', contextPercent|null, degraded, lastGateEvent|null } — e.g. line 1 'ADLC ▸ T24 (active) · ctx 41%', line 2 (only when present) 'last gate: rail-deny src/x.ts'. Pure and unit-tested; no pi imports.
2. Extension wiring: keep the setStatus pill; add the widget via ctx.ui.setWidget('adlc', lines) — refreshed on session_start, turn_start, every recorded gate event (hook the recordGateEvent call sites via a small notifier callback rather than duplicating state), and session_compact (degraded flag). Widget shows ONLY when a ticket id resolves (inert sessions get no widget; clear it with undefined when the ticket deactivates). All ui calls guarded — setWidget may not exist on older/fake ctx (optional-call + try/catch, same posture as safeUsage).
3. Message renderers: registerMessageRenderer for 'adlc-flail-advisory' and a new 'adlc-gate-notice' customType. Route the build-gate deny and bash-rail/suppression revert notices ALSO as sendMessage custom messages with that type (display:true) so they render structured in the TUI — keep the existing ctx.ui.notify as the fallback channel. Renderer implementation: read the MessageRenderer contract from types.d.ts; if it requires pi-tui Component construction that cannot run outside a TUI, isolate it in lib/renderers.mjs behind a factory that degrades to undefined in non-TUI mode (do NOT import @earendil-works/pi-tui at module top level of extension.mjs — keep the extension loadable under node --test).
4. Evidence hook refactor: recordGateEvent gains an optional onRecorded callback (or the extension wraps it) so widget refresh + gate-notice message emission live at ONE choke point, not copy-pasted per site.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: renderWidgetLines is pure and covers: active ticket with percent, error state, missing percent (omitted, not 'NaN%'), degraded flag, long titles truncated (≤ 80 chars/line). VERIFY: node --test unit cases.
- AC2: wiring — after session_start with an active ticket the fake ctx captured a setWidget('adlc', lines) whose first line names the ticket; after a rail deny the widget refreshes and includes the gate event; after deactivating the ticket (pointer removed + turn_start) the widget is cleared with undefined. VERIFY: fake-pi wiring tests.
- AC3: an inert session (no ticket) never calls setWidget with content. VERIFY: wiring test.
- AC4: a fake ctx WITHOUT setWidget/getContextUsage does not crash any handler (all gates still function). VERIFY: wiring test running the full deny path with a minimal ctx.
- AC5: registerMessageRenderer is called for both custom types at extension load; the build-gate deny path emits an 'adlc-gate-notice' sendMessage in addition to the notify. VERIFY: fake-pi assertions.
- AC6: full root `npm test` exits 0; `node scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs` passes.

Suppressions are denied; marker fixtures by concatenation. Do not modify sibling plugins or packages/**.
title: pi Phase 3b: live ADLC widget (ticket + enforcement + context + last gate) and custom message renderers
